text:
raj_sales: Heads-up — prospect (FinLedger) signed NDA, wants a 2-week POC. They require BYO CMKs, HSM-backed, and rotation policy enforcement. Can we confirm timeline, perf hit, and price delta?

sam_se: Quick answer: BYO CMK via our keystore proxy is supported. Performance depends on whether they want per-request unwrap/sign or allow us to cache wrapped intermediate keys. Typical proxied path adds ~10-20ms per request for CloudHSM, but if we do ephemeral wrapping/caching we can get it down to ~1-3ms.

alex_sre: @sam_se +1 on numbers. Also need network design notes — VPN peering or VPC-SC? If they want on-prem HSM we need static routes and egress firewall rules.

maria_sec: Security flags: they listed FIPS 140-2 Level 3 and HSM attestation, split-key requirement for custodial ops, and a 90-day rotation cadence. We should confirm which of those are MUST vs NICE-TO-HAVE in questionnaire.

raj_sales: I asked them to prioritize — they replied: MUST=HSM attestation, CMK control, audit logs; NICE=90-day strict rotation (they said "ideally 90d but can accept policy-based alerts"). They also asked for cost estimate for per-call HSM ops vs cached-wrapped keys.

sam_se: Pricing delta: engineering estimate — per-call HSM unwrap/sign: $0.0008 per request (HSM op + egress + orchestration). Wrapped-key cache approach: amortized ~ $0.00005 per request. We should label these as rough and subject to commit size.

alex_sre: Operational blockers: 1) Attestation doc — we can provide vendor attestation, but for custom on-prem HSM they might need to run their own attestation session. 2) Key rotation: we support scheduled rotations and on-demand rewraps but need an SOW if they expect us to coordinate multi-custodian ceremonies.

pocbot: New POC created: #poc-finledger-19 — owners: @raj_sales @sam_se. Link: https://redwood.internal/poc/19

raj_sales: @maria_sec can you start populating the security questionnaire answers? I'll forward the doc. Also @olivia_legal please flag any contract clauses about key custody and indemnity.

maria_sec: Starting now. Two quick Qs for the questionnaire: 1) Do we provide HSM private key material storage ever? 2) Do we support split-KEK with customer-held shares?

olivia_legal: We don't hold customer private key material for BYO-CMK — customer's keys remain in their KMS. For split-KEK, legal needs the model: are we co-custodian, or merely facilitating key negotiation? If co-custody, we need additional insurance terms.

james_sre: From SLA perspective, adding proxied KMS calls increases tail latency risk. We can introduce retries and fallback to a warmed cached key, but that changes security posture. Recommend discussing acceptable RTO/RPO for key ops with customer.

sam_se: Example config snippet for caching policy (for ops):
```
keystore:
  mode: proxy
  cache_ttl: 600s  # wrapped key TTL
  max_retries: 2
  hsm_mode: cloudhsm
```
If they set cache_ttl=0 we do per-call unwraps.

raj_sales: Customer asked for a written checklist we can hand to their InfoSec. Can we produce a short preflight bundle: network runbook, attestation/artefacts, pricing delta table, rotation playbook, SOW template?

maria_sec: I can draft the preflight bundle. Will include: HSM attestation template, audit log retention and format, rotation playbook (who signs what), and answers to the questionnaire. ETA EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

olivia_legal: I'll add contract language options for co-custody vs BYO keys and an SLA appendix for HSM-backed ops.

alex_sre: Engineering ask: If customer insists on 90d forced rotation and per-call unwrap, we'll need to size Dedicated throughput — estimate additional GPU margin for crypto proxy (roughly 15% CPU/GPU headroom). Need to know expected qps.

raj_sales: They estimate 200 qps peak, mostly short chat completions. I'll ask them to confirm real qps and whether bursts are allowed.

sam_se: Final note — for pricing, propose two lines: 1) base POC usage + 2) BYO-CMK HSM ops surcharge (per-call vs cached). That keeps commercial clean.

raj_sales: Great. I'll gather the qps and the questionnaire PDF and tag you all. Thanks team. :pray:

pocbot: Reminder — POC kickoff meeting scheduled Thu 10:00 PT.
